# Questionnaire Battery — CoVenture & NeuroVenture
Item-level content of every questionnaire in the CoVenture / NeuroVenture battery: each scale below links to a page listing every question in English and French, with response options, subscales, and skip rules.

See also the [derived variables](derived-variables.md) (computed scores and their formulas), the [cognitive task variables](tasks.md), and the [data dictionary](../data-dictionaries/coventure-neuroventure.md) (variable naming and where the data lives).

!!! tip "Finding a question"
    Use the search box at the top of any page — the question text of every item (English and French) is indexed, e.g. searching `drink as a way to celebrate` jumps straight to the DMQ item.
